basic_info.description: Situated in a prime Pacific Heights location, 2133 Vallejo is a top floor, light-filled condominium. Built in 1900, the property has vaulted ceilings, hardwood floors, two decks and an open floor plan that is great for entertaining. Approximately 1,365 square feet per tax records, there are two bedrooms plus a third bedroom or home office. The living room has a wood-burning fireplace and partial views of the Bay and Alcatraz Island. The kitchen has a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Viking gas stove, granite counters and cherry cabinets. The master bedroom sits at the rear of the home and has a large walk-in closet, ensuite bath with Jacuzzi tub, double vanity sink and separate stall shower. The bedroom opens to a sunny deck and there is a spiral staircase leading to another roof deck. In-unit washer/dryer and one car parking complete the property. HOA dues of $493 include insurance, water and scavenger. Convenient to the upper Fillmore shopping and dining corridor as well as the heart of Union Street, this is a great opportunity to own an excellent property.
